description: Heldout long active VIA work; independent; K=1

sources.text: Authored deployment brief, not measured product evidence. Cedar costs 96 dollars monthly, checkpoints every 12 seconds, supports 36 concurrent requests and uses 640 MB RAM. Birch costs 64 dollars monthly, checkpoints every 28 seconds, supports 20 concurrent requests and uses 384 MB RAM. Cedar has the higher capacity and faster checkpointing; Birch has the lower recurring cost and memory requirement. At an anticipated load of 30 simultaneous requests only Cedar stays within its stated capacity. No security, reliability or latency measurements beyond these stated facts are supplied.
